title: Objects to Think With
hero_prompt: A wide bold linocut print of a child's hands assembling a small wooden gear-machine on a workbench, thick carved black lines and flat ink shapes, loose gears and tools scattered around, evoking a thing built in order to be understood. Hand-made bold linocut print, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold linocut-style emblem of a single gear held in a hand's grip, thick flat black shapes, no fine linework, reading clearly as a strong mark at small size.
